points.name: Inside and out
points.text: From the wheels to the windows, the dashboard to the carpets.

servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: Prices start at the amounts shown and depend on vehicle size: small, medium or large.

services.name: Standard Detail
services.text: Exterior hand wash, bugs removed, rims and tires deep cleaned, windows, door jambs, tire shine, vacuum and wipe down.

services.name: Premium Detail
services.text: Everything in Standard, plus clay bar decontamination, a 6-month spray sealant, trim shine, steam-cleaned interior, and conditioned plastics and leathers.

services.name: Ultimate Detail
services.text: Standard and Premium, plus a 1-step polish, engine bay cleaned and shined, and seats and carpets shampooed.

services.name: RV Wash & Wax
services.text: A thorough clean for large vehicles that protects and brings out your RV's finish.

services.name: Exterior Detailing
services.text: Wheels to windows, polished and protected so the paint stands out.

services.name: Interior Detailing
services.text: Dashboard to carpets, refreshed with nothing left untouched.

why.name: Proven satisfaction
